candidates.detail: Assume a valid due engagement selected by the global lifecycle queue, an active candidate holding whose first participant already occupies the same property and holding, and a second participant not at that property when no capacity remains. After any applicable dowry payment, settle_due_weddings creates the new household and joins both people. The first residence admission is a no-op; the second calls the capacity check and returns an error. The global queue catches this error, cancels the commitment as ResidenceUnavailable, and records failure. If cancellation and the remainder of the enclosing scheduler succeed, pinned SpacetimeDB source documentation says successful reducers commit; source therefore predicts the earlier household changes survive a cancelled wedding. No database or reducer was executed.

The source predicts the recipient can retain that payment despite the cancellation, subject to all stated conditions and successful outer commit. Currency grant error-erasure is a separately recorded connected concern, not necessary to the household example.
